lead.tldr: US spot bitcoin ETFs see $410M outflows as BTC drops below $66,000 on strong jobs data. • $2.5B BTC options expiry today at $74,000 max pain heightens short-term volatility risks. • BlackRock boosts Bitmine shares 166% signaling bullish tokenization bet on Ethereum. • Aave Labs proposes $50M DAO package and full revenue share to settle protocol dispute. • CFTC adds crypto leaders to panel advancing US pro-innovation regulatory clarity. • BlockFills $60B trading platform pauses deposits amid extreme market fear signals.

top_signals.title: US spot bitcoin ETFs bleed $410 million as BTC slips below $66,000
top_signals.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $410 million in outflows on February 12, 2026, marking a second straight day of heavy selling and a fourth consecutive week of losses amid Bitcoin's decline to around $66,000-$68,000 from its October 2025 peak near $127,000. This reversal follows $5.7 billion in net withdrawals from November 2025 to January 2026, driven by stronger-than-expected US jobs data that dims prospects for Federal Reserve rate cuts and prompts institutional de-risking. For institutional investors, these outflows signal fading demand for Bitcoin exposure, amplify short-term supply pressure equivalent to multi-day mined supply, and heighten volatility as funds liquidate holdings to meet redemptions. Standard Chartered's cut to a $100,000 2026 price target underscores the macro risks, with average ETF buyers now facing losses from entries around $90,000.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin trading firm CEO sentenced to 20 years over $200 million ponzi scheme
top_signals.summary: The CEO of a Bitcoin trading firm has been sentenced to 20 years in prison for running a $200 million Ponzi scheme. This highlights the risks associated with unregulated crypto investment schemes.

top_signals.title: BlackRock buys up Bitmine shares as Ethereum threatens to fall to $1,400 price
top_signals.summary: BlackRock increased its Bitmine share holdings by 166% in Q4 2025. CEO Larry Fink is bullish on tokenization, viewing Ethereum as a significant beneficiary.

top_signals.title: Aave Labs Seeks $50M Package in Revenue Shift Proposal
top_signals.summary: Aave Labs is proposing a new revenue framework that would redirect product revenue to the DAO and ratify Aave V4. The proposal seeks a $50M package.

top_signals.title: Crypto leaders join CFTC panel as U.S. pushes ‘pro-innovation’ rules
top_signals.summary: Crypto leaders are joining a CFTC panel as the U.S. aims for 'pro-innovation' rules. The move could offer more regulatory clarity for the crypto industry.

top_signals.title: Nvidia-backed Nscale secures $1.4bn chip loan
top_signals.summary: Nscale, a data center builder backed by Nvidia, has secured a $1.4 billion loan to finance the acquisition of GPUs. This investment signals continued growth and demand in the data center and AI infrastructure space.

top_signals.title: Exclusive: Seligman Ventures debuts with $500 million and a new model for the blurring line between public and private markets
top_signals.summary: Seligman Ventures launches a $500 million fund focused on early-stage AI investing. The fund aims to bridge the gap between public and private markets.

top_signals.title: Crypto Use in Trafficking Surges, but May Help in Crackdowns
top_signals.summary: The use of cryptocurrency in trafficking increased by 85% in 2025, reaching hundreds of millions of dollars, according to Chainalysis. This increase may paradoxically aid in crackdowns by providing a traceable financial trail.

top_signals.title: Fiserv Launches US Dollar Settlement Platform for Digital Asset Companies
top_signals.summary: Fiserv has launched a real-time US dollar settlement platform for digital asset companies. The platform facilitates continuous transfers through insured banking partners.

top_signals.title: $60B trading giant BlockFills hits ‘pause’ as ‘extreme fear’ takes over market
top_signals.summary: BlockFills, a $60B trading giant, has reportedly paused client deposits and withdrawals due to 'extreme fear' in the market. The article questions the reasons behind this sudden shutdown.

top_signals.title: Aave Labs proposes paying DAO all revenue from Aave-branded products
top_signals.summary: Aave Labs has proposed sharing revenue from Aave-branded products with the DAO to resolve a dispute over control of the protocol. The proposal also focuses on v4 as its future direction.

top_signals.title: All about the stablecoin race after Binance integrates RLUSD on XRPL
top_signals.summary: Binance integrated Ripple's RLUSD on XRPL, positioning it as a competitor to established stablecoins like Tether and Circle. This integration expands the availability of RLUSD and potentially increases its adoption.
